description:
Climber 20'' Kids Bike

Low Step-thru Frame - Easy for kids to straddle a bike.
Safety - Single speed drivetrain, Dual v-brake & Wide tires.

The sleek frame with vibrant colors, the rugged 20-inch tires and dual handbrakes make this single speed bike ready for real riding adventures.

Durable and Comfortable

Hiland hi-ten steel frame is lightweight and durable, and its step-thru style makes kids easy to stand up and get on and off.

Plus, the comfortable seat and 20-inch wheels make this the most comfortable bike for kids to ride around the neighborhood.

Reliable Brake

Equipped with V-brakes that are lighter and easier to maintain and adjust.

Front and rear steel linear pull handbrakes with kid-sized levers are easy to pull and provide consistent and reliable stopping action on demand, allowing kids to stop quickly in case of an emergency.

Safe Riding

The single-speed design is better suited for beginners. The simple setup gives kids confidence and helps them maintain control. It is the perfect transition model for training wheels.

Wide 2.125" pneumatic tires add more stability, and trailing edge tires provide good traction in wet and dry conditions.

Assembly & Guide

85% pre-assembled, assembly tools included, easy to assemble within 25 minutes. Click on the video to see an instructional video on assembly.

Solutions will be quickly provided by support team within 24 hours! Bikes all have been inspected before package. Solve all your worries!

Double V-brake

V-brake is lighter and easier to maintain and adjust.

Single Speed Drivetrain

A simple and reliable set-up let kids easier to ride.

Low Step-thru Frame

Hiland classic style high-carbon steel frame is lower so it's easier for kids to stand over and hop on and off.

Wide Tires

Wide 2.125" pneumatic tires provide outstanding grip and stability in various terrains.

Help your child transition to real riding with the Hiland Climber 20" Kids Mountain Bike. Featuring a durable step-thru steel frame, dual V-brakes, and all-terrain tires. Perfect for boys and girls ages 5-9.
